title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.5
exact_target: Does every zero of a polynomial whose zeros lie in the closed unit disc have a critical point within distance one?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2304005 (AMR-022-4005). CC BY 4.0.

Walter K. Hayman and Edward F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory}, arXiv:1809.07200, 2018. Problems 4.5 and 4.30 (the latter explicitly defines the degree-at-least-two class), including complete Update 4.5.
